target.statement: IOP-Score of the predicate 'TSH >' in the DPG of an iForest model trained on the Annthyroid dataset, reported as -0.2429.

compute.basis: Training a 200-tree Isolation Forest on 6916 samples and building the DPG graph is lightweight; the main effort is installing dependencies and running the provided code, with some risk of missing configuration details.

blockers: Code may not be fully reproducible without specific hyperparameters (e.g., random seed, contamination) not stated in the paper.
title: Extending Decision Predicate Graphs for Comprehensive Explanation of Isolation Forest
